question: Can a larger direct-grid output tile amortize R142's exact natural-M1 K8 reduction enough to approach oneDNN latency?

fixed_semantics.k_partition: Exactly R142: eight K subgroups, 64 contiguous K positions per subgroup, 512-position interleave period.
fixed_semantics.reduction_order: Exactly R142 and observed oneDNN: p0 += p1 += p2 += p3 += p4 += p5 += p6 += p7 in FP32.
fixed_semantics.launch: Direct dense ceil(M/tileM) by ceil(N/tileN) grid with production NT weights; no persistent scheduler, atomic queue, or global scratch.
fixed_semantics.slm: Reduce accumulator fragments in fixed 16-FP32-value slices through an 8192-float/32-KiB workgroup-local buffer. All work-items execute a release/acquire barrier before and after each reusable slice; only k_sg=0 writes output.
fixed_semantics.source_and_toolchain: Same pinned commits, IntelLLVM 2026.1.1, bmg-g31-a0, diagnostic dtype guards, and build narrowing as R142.

candidates.purpose: Small-M option: halve N workgroups and work-items relative to R142 while retaining a 16-row tile.
Balanced 2048-output tile with half R142's work-items.
Direct analogue of R141's fastest exact 32x32-unroll, wg2x2x8 oneDNN geometry.
Maximum preregistered output amortization; reject on compiler spill or latency.

screen.process_isolation: Each candidate runs in a fresh bounded container selected only by R143_GEOMETRY.
screen.identity: Every complete output must equal concatenated natural oneDNN M1 rows; M512 prefixes, M128 repeat/permutation, and M168-to-M200 random-padding content must be exact.
screen.timing: Ten warmups and five samples of 100 synchronized calls at M2, M64, M128, M168, and M256 against natural oneDNN.
screen.stability: No timed sample max/min ratio may exceed 1.15.

gates.candidate: Compile, identity, and stability are required independently. A candidate proceeds only if it is <=1.15x natural on both shapes at M2, M64, and M128 and <=2.0x at M168 and M256.
gates.composition: A row-count threshold composition may use independently exact candidates. Its frozen 16:64 attention-QKV:gate-up call-count model must be <=1.03x natural at M2, M64, and M128.
gates.on_pass: Expand only the fastest exact passing candidate or composition to all six production shapes, then apply the <=1.03 frozen all-shape decode model before any server build.
gates.on_failure: Close direct-grid CUTLASS-style K8 tiling for serving. Preserve R142 as the exact executable reference and optimize/instrument the oneDNN local-K implementation itself; do not launch a server or begin collective optimization.

abort_conditions: any current-boot Xe fault, CAT error, reset, coredump, device loss, timeout, or hung stage visible to the available health interfaces
either B70 is not normal before or after a case
any unregistered geometry, arithmetic change, candidate substitution, or server launch
